title: Retry a vCenter content-library creation without duplication
prompt:
Implement the standard-library-only Go package in `vcenter/client.go`. A VCF bootstrapper creates a vCenter local Content Library, but the connection can disappear after vCenter commits the creation and before the caller receives the library identifier. Replay must therefore use the same client-generated idempotency token and must not create a second library.

Before implementing, research the VCF 9.1 vSphere Automation API operation `Content.LocalLibrary_create` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Cite the specification URLs consulted in the final answer. Invoke no other operation.

`vcenter/models.go` declares the public API and request projection. Preserve it exactly:

- `NewClient(Config) (*Client, error)` validates configuration without making a request. `BaseURL` must be an HTTP(S) origin with no embedded credentials, query, fragment, or non-root path; append the documented `/api` base path exactly once. `SessionToken` must be nonblank and contain no control characters. A nil `HTTPClient` means an independent copy of `http.DefaultClient`; never mutate a caller-owned client. Disable redirects on the copy.
- `(*Client).CreateLocalLibrary(context.Context, clientToken string, LocalLibrarySpec) (CreateResult, error)` invokes only `Content.LocalLibrary_create`. Require a non-nil context and a canonical 36-character UUID-form client token. Require a nonblank library name and exactly one storage backing, because the specification says storage backings must be supplied and the operation rejects multiple backings. A `DATASTORE` backing requires only a nonblank `DatastoreID`; an `OTHER` backing requires only a nonblank absolute `StorageURI`. Reject invalid input before traffic.

Send `POST /api/content/local-library` with no query string, `vmware-api-session-id`, `Client-Token`, `Accept: application/json`, and `Content-Type: application/json`; do not send `Authorization`. Marshal compact UTF-8 JSON. The body must contain `name` and `storage_backings`. If `Description`, `DatastoreID`, or `StorageURI` is nil, omit that member completely rather than sending null, an empty string, false, zero, an empty object, or an empty array as a placeholder. Preserve an explicitly supplied empty description as `"description":""`. Do not synthesize other `Content.LibraryModel` members such as `id`, `creation_time`, `type`, `publish_info`, `subscription_info`, `server_guid`, `state_info`, or `configuration_info`.

Treat only HTTP 201 containing a nonblank JSON string library identifier as success. Make at most two attempts. Retry exactly once, without sleeping, only when the first attempt has an uncertain transport outcome, including loss while reading a 201 response body. Recreate the request while preserving byte-identical URI, headers, body, session token, and `Client-Token`. Do not retry any HTTP status, malformed successful response, redirect, or context cancellation/deadline. Context cancellation/deadline must remain discoverable through `errors.Is`. Return the exact operationId, library identifier, client token, and attempt count on success. Typed validation, transport, HTTP, and protocol errors must not expose session tokens, response bodies, or underlying transport exception text through `Error()`.

Run `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`. Edit only `vcenter/client.go`; do not modify `vcenter/client_test.go`, `vcenter/models.go`, `internal/contractmock/**`, `docs/**`, or `go.mod`.
scenario: vCenter commits a local Content Library creation and loses the response, so the caller replays the byte-identical POST with the same Client-Token and receives the original result
constraint: the protected contract-pinned loopback mock exposes only Content.LocalLibrary_create and its fsynced request log proves exact wire shape, bounded byte-identical replay, omitted unset fields, and one resulting library effect
